method.hypotheses: Predeclared within this study: current policy vs reclaim only after completed signal candle >3 ATR; for 4h also a complete trail from 1R / 20% peak giveback / floor 0.5R from 1R, no stepped or stall tightening. No threshold search. Each candidate changes one dimension only.
method.entry: Reclaim uses 0.25 ATR pullback, a later closed minute reclaim, then a passive limit; 15 minute setup, 3 minute order lifetime, 10 order placements per UTC day. Original ATR risk distance; unchanged margin and risk cap.
method.economics: Isolated cells, each $1000, $150 max margin, 5x requested base leverage; full configured maker/taker commission and tax; existing 6x gate, regime, alignment and scanner exit policies. Minute stop-first ambiguity; only post-order candle fills. Current contract specs. Funding only where recorded; older settlements and historical depth/queue missing.
method.robustness: Two 28-day windows, each starts flat. Both are exploratory, not pristine holdouts: cells selected from observed losses. Sources checked on truncated history. Same-fill extra 6bp roundtrip haircut also reported; independent cost reruns can change admissions.
method.exclusions: No shared-account occupancy/ML/dynamic leverage, live post-entry depth or historical quote reconstruction. Sum across cells is not portfolio P&L. Report missing minutes, open positions, rejected entries and missed baseline winners. No configuration writes.

followupMethod: Follow-up exploratory hypothesis after the initial 96 replays: on 4h require last completed daily close and EMA21 slope to agree with entry side. Uses existing causal alignment implementation, no threshold search. Selected because 50 of 51 last-day 4h stops were longs; NOT an untouched validation.
decisions: Deploy transaction reservation and deferred-execution rollback fixes after regression validation.
Do not enable universal expansion retests: AKE deteriorates and AIN/ARIA miss profitable entries.
Do not enable a fleet-wide 4h runner or daily-alignment gate: results differ by scanner/window and samples are small.
Preserve $150 maximum margin, 6x cost policy and all trading configuration.
